elevation.demUsedForReference: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM (1 m lidar; ImageServer getSamples)

published.value: "The main elevation change can be found between Turns 13 and 16, with the track heading over an exit ramp and under various flyovers across uneven ground." "The Turn 14-15 chicane has an uphill approach, with a crest in the middle of the chicane and then drops down on exit."

famousFeatures.feature: Turn 14-15 chicane: uphill approach, crest, drop on exit
famousFeatures.real: lidar (flown 2024-04, after the circuit was built): +3.0 m from s 3262 to the crest at s ~3350, 5.5 % over 50 m (s 3302), then -3.6 % down (s 3482)
famousFeatures.game: flat: 0.6 % / -0.7 % at most anywhere; the game's highest point is at s 811 (a GLO-90 artefact in sector 1)

banking.method: lidar heights at +-4 m across the OSM centreline every 10 m; tilt = atan((hLeft - hRight) / 8 m)

findings.game: GLO-90 surface model, FLAT_TRACKS (median 325 m, Gaussian 250 m, scaled to <= 4 m): range 2.8 m, max 50 m grades +0.6 / -0.7 %; shape uncorrelated with the ground (r = 0.217, rms 0.74 m)
findings.real: USGS 3DEP lidar (2024) along the OSM centreline: range 3.5 m; flat (1-2 m ASL) except the Turn 13-16 rise: 5.5 % up over 50 m into the Turn 14-15 chicane, crest ~4.4 m ASL, -3.6 % down after it - the published "uphill approach, crest in the middle of the chicane, drops down on exit"
findings.proposedFix: ELEV_SOURCE['us-2022'] = 'usgs3dep' and remove 'us-2022' from FLAT_TRACKS. Predicted in game (build DTM filters + js/track.js smoothing on this lidar profile): range 2.9 m, chicane climb 3.7 % / drop -2.5 % over 50 m (with DTM median half 1 / sigma 10 m for this track: 4.4 / -2.8 %)
sources: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, 1 m lidar (public domain): https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer (getSamples), acquisition dates from https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json?...&includeDate=true

findings.game: no structure over the track (no bridge in scenery-data.js for us-2022)
findings.real: the Turn 13-16 section passes under three Florida's Turnpike ramp bridges (OSM motorway_link, layer 1-2: s 3369.3, 3423.5, 3499.9 m) and the lap under two footbridges (s 1297, 1594.3 m)
findings.proposedFix: add the three flyover decks over Turns 13-16 (and the two footbridges): linear OSM bridge ways buffered to their width (ramps: 1-2 lanes)
